title: Stonebridge Software Form 8-K repurchase authorization
bodyText:
UNITED STATES
FORM 8-K
Item 8.01 Other Events.
On May 13, 2026, Stonebridge Software announced that its board authorized a new stock repurchase program to buy back up to $150 million of common stock over the next 18 months. Repurchases may be made through open market transactions or privately negotiated transactions.
